title: Send a Grafana alert to Slack

blocks.content:
Welcome to the hands-on learning path that connects Grafana Alerting to a Slack channel end to end.

In this path, you get a Slack credential, create and test a Slack contact point, connect an alert rule to it and watch a real notification arrive, then replace the default title and body with a template you pasted and previewed.

## Here's what to expect

When you complete this path, you'll be able to:

- Create a Slack app with the scopes it needs, install it, and copy the bot token and channel ID, or create a Slack incoming webhook and copy its URL
- Create a Slack contact point, enter the credential, and confirm a test message in the channel
- Connect an alert rule to the contact point, on the rule or through one child policy, and confirm a real notification in the channel
- Check the two routing causes of a missing notification before touching the contact point
- Override **Title** and **Text Body** with a working template, preview it against a real alert, and read the result for a missing value

## Before you begin

Before you start, ensure you have:

- A Grafana Cloud account. To create one, refer to [Grafana Cloud](https://grafana.com/signup/cloud/connect-account).
- Permission to create contact points and edit alert rules.
- A Slack workspace where you can install a Slack app, or a Workspace Owner you can ask to approve the install. Nothing in this path can be checked without one.
- A Grafana-managed alert rule you can make fire. This path uses the **QuickPizza server errors** rule from the [Create your first alert rule](https://grafana.com/docs/learning-paths/alerting-first-rule/) path. If you don't have it, complete that path first, or use another Grafana-managed rule you can make fire.

You are on the Grafana Alertmanager unless someone changed the **Choose Alertmanager** dropdown. **Test** on a contact point and the template preview work only there.

## Troubleshooting

If you get stuck, we've got your back! Where appropriate, troubleshooting information is just a click away.

## More to explore

After the templated notification arrives, explore notification policies in depth to route several rules to several channels, and the template examples for dashboard links and label lists.
